name: 01721 · Ashland, MA
findings: ZIP 01721 (Ashland) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01721 (Ashland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01721 (Ashland) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
